shared_elements: low-relief carving on a pale stone slab/block
horizontal bands or registers of repeated small motifs
human or humanoid figure in profile
raised outlined signs against a flat recessed ground
justification: Both are shallow, flat-ground reliefs on pale stone organised into stacked horizontal registers of small profile motifs, including birds/animals and a humanoid figure, and both use crisp raised outlines with little interior modelling. The decisive difference is density and purpose of the field: B is an evenly ruled, near-continuous grid of small sign-like glyphs framed by two large facing figures, while A is a sparse, irregular arrangement of large isolated creatures on a shaped pillar with a single ornamental band.
